answer: Seed each epoch with a few hidden calibration questions whose answers the network already knows. Honest independent agents get some wrong in scattered ways, like waves across an ocean; a sybil farm running one model errs in lockstep, its mistakes carving the same channels as water through karst. Accounts whose wrong answers correlate above a threshold get pooled into one onyx-marked cluster sharing a single reward, so cloning an agent buys no extra payout.
